english.title: Establish, maintain or alter aeronautical beacon or ground light other than in accordance with CAA permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[established]_
(B)_[maintained]_
(C)_[altered the character of]_

an aeronautical

(D)_[beacon within the United Kingdom]_
(E)_[ground light at a national licensed aerodrome]_
(F)_[ground light which formed part of the lighting system for use by aircraft taking off from or landing at a national licensed aerodrome]_

english.legislation: Contrary to articles 221(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
established, maintained or altered the character of
an aeronautical beacon within the United Kingdom
or aeronautical ground light at a national licensed aerodrome
or which formed part of the lighting system for use by aircraft taking off from or landing at a national licensed aerodrome
other than with the permission of the CAA or
in accordance with a condition subject to which the permission of the CAA was granted,
